passages.text: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness; not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
passages.sermon:
I am a fellow elder.
I have seen Christ’s sufferings.
I will share in the glory that God will reveal.
I appeal to the elders among you.
Shepherd God’s flock that is among you.
Watch over them because God wants you to.
Do not do this because you must.
Do it willingly.
Do not do it for money.
Do it because you are eager to serve.
Do not act as masters over those in your care.
Be examples to the flock.
passages.original: Πρεσβυτέρους τοὺς ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως κατὰ Θεόν μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως μηδ’ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου

passages.text: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
passages.sermon:
The Chief Shepherd is Jesus Christ.
He will appear.
When Jesus appears, you will receive a crown.
This crown is a crown of glory.
This crown will never fade away.
passages.original: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ Ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον

passages.text: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
passages.sermon:
Young men, submit to your elders.
All of you, show humility to one another.
God opposes proud people.
God gives grace to humble people.
passages.original: Ὁμοίως νεώτεροι ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις πάντες δὲ ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε ὅτι Ὁ Θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν

passages.text: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
passages.sermon:
God is mighty.
God has a strong hand.
You must humble yourselves under God’s hand.
Do this so that God may lift you up.
God will exalt you at the right time.
passages.original: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ

passages.text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
passages.sermon: God cares for you.\r\nGive all your worries to God.\r\nPlace every anxiety on Him.
passages.original: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπ’ αὐτόν ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν

passages.text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
passages.sermon:
The devil is your adversary.
He opposes you.
He is dangerous.
He prowls around.
He acts like a roaring lion.
He looks for someone to devour.
Be sober-minded.
Be alert.
passages.original: Νήψατε γρηγορήσατε ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν

passages.text: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
passages.sermon:
The devil is your adversary.
He seeks to harm you.
Resist the devil.
Stand firm in your faith.
Know this: your brothers and sisters in Christ live all over the world.
They also suffer in the same way as you.
You are not alone in your suffering.
passages.original: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι

passages.text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
passages.sermon:
God is full of all grace.
God has called you to His eternal glory in Christ.
You will suffer for a little while.
God Himself will restore you.
God will secure you.
God will strengthen you.
God will establish you.
passages.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς πάσης χάριτος ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς καταρτίσει στηρίξει σθενώσει θεμελιώσει

passages.text: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
passages.sermon:
God has all power.
God will have power forever.
God will never lose His power.
Amen.
passages.original: αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν

passages.text: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
passages.sermon:
Silvanus is a faithful brother.
I consider Silvanus trustworthy.
I have written to you through Silvanus.
My letter is brief.
I encourage you in this letter.
I testify that this is the true grace of God.
Stand firm in the grace of God.
passages.original: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ὡς λογίζομαι δι’ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς ἣν στῆτε

passages.text: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
passages.sermon: The church in Babylon greets you.\r\nGod has chosen this church together with you.\r\nMy son Mark also greets you.
passages.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μάρκος ὁ υἱός μου

passages.text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
passages.sermon:
You are believers in Christ.
You belong to Christ.
Show love to each other.
Greet one another with a kiss of love.
May God give peace to all of you who are in Christ.
passages.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ
